o: In the municipality of Pećinci, near Šabac, Novi Sad and Belgrade
questions.e: In the video: "Sibač, seoce u opštini Pećinci, koje se nalazi u blizini tri velika grada" — Sibač, a small village in the municipality of Pećinci, located near three big cities.

questions.q: What advantage over Belgrade does Sibač have, according to the interviewees?
questions.e: In the video: "imaju i jednu prednost koju Beograđani nemaju: nemaju konstantnu buku, vrevu i brojne stresove." — they also have one advantage that Belgraders don't: no constant noise, bustle and numerous stresses.

questions.q: Where did Branko work all his life?
questions.e: In the video: "Branko je radio ceo svoj radni vek u Naftagasu" — Branko worked his entire working life at Naftagas.
In the video: "Ja sam bila domaćica i poljoprivrednica" — I was a housewife and a farmer.

questions.q: What does she call "the bank in the house"?
o: The harvest and the pigs they raised
questions.e: In the video: "To nam je bila banka u kući. Svinje, da ne pričam" — that was our bank in the house. The pigs, not to mention. (The harvest and the pigs.)

questions.q: How many years have the spouses been together?
questions.e: In the video: "54 godine ste zajedno" — you've been together 54 years.

questions.q: How do the spouses divide the work on the farm?
o: He mows, she takes care of the flowers
questions.e: In the video: "ja pokosim, a ona je oko cveća" — I mow, and she looks after the flowers.

questions.q: What is done with the meat after slaughter?
o: Salted, kept in a barrel of brine for 3–4 weeks and hung in the smokehouse
questions.e: In the video: "usolimo meso, stavimo u bure, u salamuru, da odstoji jedno tri, četiri nedelje, i onda vešamo gore u pušnicu." — we salt the meat, put it in a barrel, in brine, to stand for about three, four weeks, and then hang it up in the smokehouse.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Strateška pozicija je donosila prednosti njegovim *žiteljima*.
questions.e: Žitelj — a resident.

questions.q: Nije bilo *asfaltirano*, ni trotoara nije bilo.
questions.e: Asfaltirati — to pave with asphalt.
Potrepštine — necessities, supplies.
Vreva — noise, bustle, jostling.
Poljoprivreda — agriculture; poljoprivrednica — a woman farmer.

questions.q: To je moj *obor*, tamo i tu.
questions.e: Obor — a pen, a sty.
Pušnica — a smokehouse; puša — to smoke.

questions.q: Ja *pokosim*, a ona je oko cveća.
questions.e: Pokositi — to mow grass.
U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u opštini.
Od ("from") requires the genitive case: od oba sveta.
Život of what? Genitive case: ruralnog mesta.

questions.q: Branko je radio ceo radni vek u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u Naftagasu.
Iz ("from") requires the genitive case: iz Dobanovaca.
Iz requires the genitive case: iz druge ulice.
After a number ending in 4 the genitive singular is used: godine.
Zaći u + accusative case: u penzionerske vode — "into pensioner waters", i.e. they retired.
